## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Include a before / after example if useful.

## Risk and rollout

Describe compatibility, security, configuration, or migration concerns. For deployments, include rollback steps.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; behavior changes have appropriate tests.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or generated clutter are included.
- [ ] Dependencies and permissions have been reviewed.
